newsitem.title: USA: Cognizant sees Q3 pre-tax gain of $28.8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Cognizant sees Q3 pre-tax gain of $28.8 mln.

text.p: Cognizant Corp said Monday that it expects to post a pretax gain of $28.8 million in the third quarter of 1997 from the sale of stock in Aspect Development Inc.
Aspect develops enterprise client/server software and reference data products.

"Our sale of Aspect reflects the strong market demand for technology stocks," said Victoria R. Fash, Cognizant's executive vice president and chief financial officer, in a statement. "Consistent with our policy of monetizing properties which don't augment core businesses, the $31.1 million of cash proceeds returns value to our shareholders."

Cognizant Corp's main units include IMS, which offers global information solutions to the pharmaceutical and healthcare industries; Nielsen Media Research; and a majority interest in Gartner Group, which provides research and advisory services to the information technology industry.
